title: Project Atlas M1 Daily Learning Loop
purpose: Transform Learn-it into a local personal learning system that builds an explainable 5, 15 or 30 minute session from observed learner evidence, guides the session, rewards pedagogically useful progress and resumes reliably on desktop and Android without any runtime LLM or network dependency.

included: deterministic local recommendation and session planning

ATLAS-LEARNING.mission: Implement pure evidence interpretation, recommendation ranking, explanation reason codes and deterministic session planning behind the frozen data contracts.

ATLAS-EXPERIENCE.mission: Implement isolated Today, guided-session, summary, knowledge-map and pedagogical-reward presentation without redefining learning semantics.

ATLAS-CORE.mission: Implement immutable events, projections, isolated local storage, controlled clock, export/import and resume primitives behind data-only interfaces.

ATLAS-CONTENT.mission: Produce two representative Atlas-ready v2 kits and authoring checks with explicit objectives, practice, correction, validation and transfer coverage without changing the v2 schema.

independentQa.mission: Challenge the exact integrated candidate with deterministic, temporal, interruption, invalid-content, reward-integrity and no-network scenarios without modifying product files.

integration.mission: Compose exact accepted lane heads into one candidate, reconcile shared composition and build inputs, and run the full matrix without silently repairing lane-owned product files.
integration.promotionGate: independent QA plus desktop and Android human validation of the exact candidate artifact

invariants: No runtime LLM, remote API call, secret or network dependency is introduced.
The same history, content, controlled clock and engine version produce the same normalized session plan and deterministic planId; runtime sessionId is assigned only when execution starts.
Learning events are immutable, fields are required by event kind, and non-applicable identifiers are absent rather than fabricated.
Practice, correction and validation remain distinct.
Every recommendation exposes reason codes from the frozen M1 canonical registry.
Gamification rewards pedagogical evidence and never click volume, time consumption, public rank or punitive streaks.
The four development lanes have no overlapping owned file path.
The learnit.kit.v2 schema remains unchanged in M1.
INT never silently repairs a lane-owned product file.
The exact tested HTML artifact is the artifact proposed for promotion.
No autonomous merge, direct main write or release publication is authorized.
requiredEvidence: Bootstrap PR records the constitution, accepted ADR, shared contracts version 0.2, work package and updated governor state.
Each lane starts from the exact bootstrap merge commit and changes only its allowlist.
Developer tests and independent QA remain separate.
Independent QA tests deterministic planning, event-kind validation, interruptions, invalid inputs, reward integrity and no-network operation.
Two clean builds are byte-for-byte identical.
The exact tested HTML artifact is downloadable.
Desktop and Android human validation pass before promotion.
adversarialTests: Reject any runtime network request or LLM integration.
Reject a LearningEvent with missing kind-required fields or fabricated non-applicable identifiers.
Reject validation credit originating from a practice activity.
Reject a corrected item being represented as durable mastery or certification.
Reject a session plan without reason codes from the canonical M1 registry.
Reject non-deterministic normalized plans or planIds under identical controlled inputs.
Reject rewards generated only from clicks, elapsed time or repeated trivial activity.
Reject loss of events after interruption, close, reopen, export or import.
Reject a lane patch that touches a shared composition path it does not own.
Reject a schema change to learnit.kit.v2.
Reject an integrated candidate whose source manifest or artifact differs from the accepted heads.
independentReview: Issue #130 is the single M1 authority.
QA remains independent from all four development lanes.
Governor review is required only for contract or scope changes, irreversible migration, candidate acceptance and promotion.
Linus arbitrates architecture conflicts and Steve arbitrates user-experience conflicts.
rollback: Revert the integrated Atlas M1 candidate and discard its isolated Atlas storage. The promoted Learning Loop V2 baseline 06c06d5ea0cadcb3cb2084769ff5ada4d0fe0a35 and its exact artifact remain available.
